threshold_basis: 晶圓代工資本密集特性＋公司自身歷史中位數；門檻為可調整 MVP 參數，後續以 foundry peer median / MAD 校準
evidence_basis: 晶圓代工高資本投入是產業常態，資本支出本身不直接列為風險；需同時觀察自由現金流與毛利率，避免把正常擴產誤判為負面。
evidence_references: TWSE / MOPS official filings: capital expenditure, cash flow and income-statement fields
TSMC annual reports discuss capital spending as capacity and technology investment

rules.name: 擴產、自由現金流與毛利率壓力
rules.logic_expression: capex_intensity > historical_median + gap AND free_cash_flow < 0 AND gross_margin_change_pp <= margin_drop
rules.rationale: 晶圓代工高資本支出本身不是負面；只有當投入明顯高於公司歷史基準，同時自由現金流為負且毛利率下滑時，才提高關注。
rules.evidence_basis: 高資本密集子產業應用公司自身歷史基準，並以現金流與毛利率作為資本投入是否形成壓力的交叉證據。
evidence_references: TWSE / MOPS official filings: capital expenditure, cash flow and income-statement fields
TSMC annual reports discuss capital spending as capacity and technology investment
rules.llm_interpretation_guardrail: LLM 可解釋資本投入、毛利率與自由現金流之間的關聯，但不得把高 CapEx 單獨判定為負面，也不得更改 deterministic verdict。
